root_cause.text: The nameserver's `ctrl_cmd_bye()` function fails to free the `qrtr_node` memory after processing a BYE packet, causing a memory leak when a node disconnects.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "the nameserver doesn't free the node memory even after processing the BYE packet. This causes the node memory to leak." The patch adds `xa_erase(&nodes, from->sq_node); kfree(node);` to ensure the node is removed from the Xarray and freed on both success and failure paths.

The patch adds `xa_erase(&nodes, from->sq_node); kfree(node);` to ensure the node is removed from the Xarray and freed on both success and failure paths.

intent_record.intent_summary: Initialize ret to 0 to avoid returning an uninitialized value from ctrl_cmd_bye.
intent_record.what: Changed the declaration of local variable ret from uninitialized to initialized with value 0 in function ctrl_cmd_bye.
intent_record.how: Ensures that ret is set to 0 by default, preventing the function from returning an undefined value if ret is not assigned before a return statement.

intent_record.intent_summary: Ensure cleanup (delete_node) is performed even when local_node is NULL, fixing a potential resource leak.
intent_record.what: Changed early return when local_node is NULL to instead set ret=0 and goto delete_node label.
intent_record.how: Ensures that cleanup code at delete_node label is executed even when local_node is not found, preventing skipped cleanup.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix resource leak and ignore -ENODEV error in ctrl_cmd_bye by ensuring node cleanup before returning.
intent_record.what: Changed error handling in ctrl_cmd_bye to jump to a cleanup label (delete_node) instead of returning early, and set ret to 0 after loop to ignore -ENODEV.
intent_record.how: Previously, errors from kernel_sendmsg (except -ENODEV) caused immediate return without freeing the node or removing it from the xarray, leading to memory and resource leaks. Now, on any error, the code performs cleanup by erasing the node from the xarray and freeing it, then returns the error code (or 0 for -ENODEV).

grouping_result.intent: Initialize ret to 0 to avoid returning an uninitialized value from ctrl_cmd_bye.
Fix resource leak and ignore -ENODEV error in ctrl_cmd_bye by ensuring node cleanup before returning.

consistency_review.core_intent: Fix resource leak and ensure proper cleanup in ctrl_cmd_bye by handling node deletion even when local_node is NULL.

relevance_review.reason: The change initializes a variable to avoid an uninitialized return value, which is unrelated to the memory leak of qrtr_node in the same function.
The group's changes directly address the memory leak in ctrl_cmd_bye by ensuring node cleanup (delete_node) is performed properly, which matches the vulnerability root cause.

candidates.rationale: Early return when local_node is NULL skips all cleanup, causing a memory leak of the qrtr_node.
Error return after sending BYE command exits without freeing the qrtr_node, leading to resource leak.
Normal completion return lacks deallocation of the qrtr_node, causing memory leak on every BYE processing.
